about.title: About
about.body: Kur degalai is a free static website (PWA) rebuilt daily with current fuel prices at every fuel station in Lithuania. All filtering and calculations run in your browser; there is no account and no tracking.
about.disclaimer: Prices may differ from the pump. Data is updated once per working day and is published for information only.
about.source.lea: Prices: Lithuanian Energy Agency (LEA) and the station chains that report to it.
about.source.geo: Geocoding: Photon (komoot). Routing: OSRM / OpenRouteService, with a haversine fallback.
about.offline: Works offline with the last known prices.
status.noData: No price data yet. Run the data pipeline.
